title: Daily Universe File
x_note: The ONE universe file every voice reads (BL-011). Produced by tools/universe_build.py from output/aqe_daily_export.json — the AQE export IS the scored universe (D-66, handoff/08 Lane 1). ONE fixed shape: {date, source, count, names[], near_misses[]} plus the four verbatim market-weather blocks {macro_weather, srm, regime, intermarket} added 2026-08-14 (PM ruling) for the druckenmiller + crown menus. Tightened 2026-07-22 to REJECT the drifted hand-assembled shapes (e.g. {date, regime, vix, candidates, held} with no names[]) — note `regime` is now a LEGITIMATE top-level block, but it never substitutes for names[], which stays required.

source.description: provenance — the AQE export this universe was shaped from (kind='aqe_daily_export' + its date)

names.description: the scored universe — the ONLY names voices nominate from — each TRIMMED to the consumed field set (x_consumed_fields)

near_misses.description: AQE's own just-below-floor band [sc_floor-5, sc_floor) — SURFACED for PM/committee revival, NOT nominated. Same trimmed shape + near_miss_reason.

macro_weather.description: OPTIONAL carried block (x_carried_blocks) — the AQE macro_weather object copied VERBATIM from the export: cross-asset direction/ROC for TLT, UUP, HYG, IWM, GLD, CPER, USO and the copper/gold ratio, plus regime_description. Whole-market, not per-name. The kernel derives nothing from it; shape is owned by contracts/aqe_export.schema.json.

srm.description: OPTIONAL carried block (x_carried_blocks) — the AQE srm[] sector-rotation table copied VERBATIM from the export: one row per sector ETF with grade, trend_state, sh_value, ROC and the RRG quadrant/direction. The per-name twins of these live on names[] as sector_rrg_quadrant / sector_rrg_direction / sector_trend_state.

regime.description: OPTIONAL carried block (x_carried_blocks) — the AQE regime object copied VERBATIM from the export (vix, level, and whatever else AQE stamps). NOT a substitute for names[]: the 2026-07-22 tightening rejects a universe that carries regime INSTEAD of a scored longlist, and names[] remains required.

intermarket.description: OPTIONAL carried block (x_carried_blocks) — the AQE intermarket object copied VERBATIM from the export: as_of plus the UUP / TLT / HYG / SPY-vs-IWM cross-asset reads. Whole-market, not per-name.
